message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in “fetch holidays” tool, but I can give you a quick rundown of the federal long‑weekends that Canadians typically enjoy in 2023. (Keep in mind that provincial/territorial holidays can add extra long‑weekends, so you’ll want to double‑check your specific region if that matters for your app.)

| Long‑Weekend | Federal Holiday(s) | Observed Dates | Notes |
|--------------|--------------------|----------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) – observed Jan 2 (Mon) | Creates a Sat‑Sun‑Mon long weekend |
| **Family Day** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, SK) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Mon‑Tue‑Wed long weekend |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Thu‑Fri‑Sat long weekend |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | Mon‑Tue‑Wed long weekend |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) – observed Jul 3 (Mon) | Sat‑Sun‑Mon long weekend |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Mon‑Tue‑Wed long weekend |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Nov 10 (Wed) – observed for Nov 11 (Thu) | Wed‑Thu‑Fri long weekend |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Mon‑Tue‑Wed long weekend |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Mon‑Tue‑Wed long weekend |

### Quick Summary of Long‑Weekend Dates (2023)

- **Jan 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) – New Year’s
- **Feb 20–22** (Mon‑Tue‑Wed) – Family Day
- **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) – Good Friday
- **May 22–24** (Mon‑Tue‑Wed) – Victoria Day
- **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) – Canada Day
- **Sep 4–6** (Mon‑Tue‑Wed) – Labour Day
- **Oct 9–11** (Mon‑Tue‑Wed) – Thanksgiving
- **Nov 10–12** (Wed‑Thu‑Fri) – Remembrance Day (observed)
- **Dec 25–27** (Mon‑Tue‑Wed) – Christmas

These are the federal holidays that generate long weekends across most of Canada in 2023. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Civic Holiday in Ontario, etc.), let me know and I can add those as well.
